$comment: COPY → ~/.paseo-pi-team/cluster-routing.local.json on the CONTROLLER host. Never commit the local copy. This is the single controller-local route file: every host in the cluster is described here, each with its own connection, capabilities, concurrency limits and per-class routes. Endpoint VALUES (pairing offers / remote targets) live ONLY in environment variables referenced by NAME via 'endpointEnv' — never inside this file. Run 'pteam models' ON EACH HOST to list what every role provider actually offers (or 'pteam models --provider <role-provider>' for one, with its thinking options). Route shapes follow the family exactly as in model-routing.example.json: pi = '<pi-provider>/<model-id>' with thinking ∈ off|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max, claude = a bare model id with thinking ∈ off|low|medium|high|xhigh|max|ultracode. For custom pi models in ~/.pi/agent/models.json, a thinkingLevelMap entry of null means the level is silently clamped by pi — treat it as unsupported.
